notes: Size 6.5" from the frame size in the model name (the datasheet doesn't state it). Xmax 7 mm is half the published linear coil travel (14 mm peak to peak). Moving mass 14.6 g already agrees with Fs and Cms, so the air load (0.56 g) isn't added. Coaxial: the woofer's parameters (the tweeter's are left out).
